## What you did

- Made the flaky `test_acs_rejects_expired_assertion` deterministic by freezing the clock instead of sleeping, then converted the two other timing-dependent SAML ACS tests the same way — 50/50 green on repeat [1]
- Cleared the ruff 0.8 and mypy backlog in `kestrel/auth` (missing Issuer/Subject now returns a 401 instead of a 500) and split `saml_utils.py` into a `saml/` package with the old imports kept working; full suite green [1]
- Shipped that cleanup on a separate branch as PR #423, deliberately leaving #418 untouched [1]

## What changed

- Maya approved and merged #418 last night: assertion signature verification ships with the staging deploy [3]
- The Fernhill end-to-end SSO walkthrough is confirmed for Thursday 10am NY time with their Okta tenant — Priya runs the demo, you just need to be on the call [1]

## What is still open

- #423: Tom Becker requested changes — he wants the module move split from the lint fixes into two PRs (1,900-line diff), and says he'll approve both today [4]
- The replay cache for assertion IDs is still in-memory only, so an assertion can be replayed against another of the 3 API pods; moving it to Redis was your plan for today [1]
